title: Ricursive Intelligence Focuses on AI-Designed Chips
excerpt: Startup Ricursive Intelligence is developing AI technology to automate and accelerate the chip design process.
body_html:
Startup Ricursive Intelligence is working on artificial intelligence designed to create computer chips. According to the company's founders, the system is built to learn from every iteration and improve future layouts.

The main goal of this initiative is to automate and speed up the overall chip design process. By leveraging AI for hardware development, the startup aims to address current challenges related to the compute crisis.
